description_expanded: Description Description Prominence 30A rental, Emerald Waves, located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. 6 Seater Golf Cart Included! Family and Kid Friendly, walk to shops at The Big Chill right out the front door. This home is one of only five units like it on the south side of 30A right at the Big Chill. LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOODGreat pull out, two-person bed in living room, way more comfortable than a pull out couch. There is plenty of room for gathering while meals are prepared as the open floor plan allows for easy sight into the living area. Three sets of double french doors open out to your balcony. Checkout the balcony in the pictures, DIRECTLY overlooking the dozens of shops and venues at The Big Chill (formerly The Hub). Kids can build a bear eating ice cream. Moms get your hair AND nails done sipping coffee or wine. Dads can stop by Luke Bryan's cigar bar and watch the game. The Big Chill has a large stage for concerts/activities and amassive jumbotron screen. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 2 Bedroom - Beachside of 30A * 6 Seater Golf Cart * Walk or Bike Everywhere - 17 mile bike path * Large Living Area - 55" Smart TV, Queen Sleeper * Private Balcony * Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Main Bedroom - King Bed, 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 42" Smart TV * Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo * 3 Seating Areas * Full Size Washer/Dryer * FREE High Speed Wi-Fi * Incredible Location * Sleeps 6 30A Public Beach Access Points About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools.Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east.COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct)Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally.Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities.INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
